summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) to implement write-enabled folder sharing, including API backend, owner UI, and recipient UI for a cipher-box application.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 was fully executed and verified with 3/3 plans complete. Four UAT bugs were discovered and fixed during the checkpoint, plus two additional issues found during human verification testing (file re-encryption key propagation). E2E tests were written to cover the new write-sharing flows.

repo: The cipher-box-ci-debug checkout does not have .env files — they must be copied from the main cipher-box repo at ../cipher-box/
The web app has no VITE_API_URL set by default and falls back to window.location.origin + '/api' (port 5173), which is wrong when API runs on port 3000
SDK packages must be built before running the web dev server: core → sdk-core → sdk in dependency order
The NestJS API uses detached processes for stability; background task kills won't take down the server if started with nohup/disown
Swagger/OpenAPI spec at /api-docs-json doesn't update until the API is restarted AND @ApiProperty enum decorators are updated — changing only the DTO class enum is insufficient

The owner's file update flow (useFileOperations.ts handleUpdateFile) does not re-wrap the new file key for share recipients — a pre-existing gap that manifests when a recipient tries to read a file the owner has since edited
Permission downgrade clears encryptedIpnsKey from the Share entity but does not delete share_keys, so recipient can still access file keys after downgrade
E2E tests live in tests/web-e2e/ with page objects per component; multi-account wallet utilities are in tests/web-e2e/utils/multi-account-wallet.ts

code.finding: Shared upload sets fileMetaIpnsName: '' — original PoC limitation that caused 'File metadata IPNS name not available' errors. Fixed by inlining full IPNS keypair generation.
Save handler uses the owner's updateFile path (useFolder hook) which fails for shared files with 'Parent folder not found or vault not initialized'. Fixed with onSaveSharedFile callback prop.
Checks item.fileMetaIpnsName which is empty for files uploaded through shared folders under the old code path.

keyType was constrained to 'file' | 'folder'. Extended to 'file' | 'folder' | 'file-ipns' to support storing recipient-wrapped IPNS private keys separately from the owner-wrapped copy in the FilePointer.
handleUpdateFile does not call reWrapForRecipients after updating file metadata. After the owner edits a file, all share recipients lose access because the new file key is never wrapped for them.
addShareKeys authorization was owner-only. Relaxed to also allow write-share recipients to add keys to their own share (they can only affect their own access).

workflow: Background task kills in Claude Code conversation context can kill dev server processes — use nohup/disown to detach processes from the conversation
When NestJS DTO enums change, both the class validator enum AND the @ApiProperty enum decorator must be updated, then the API must be fully restarted before regenerating the API client

The GSD checkpoint pattern (autonomous: false) provides a useful UAT gate that blocks wave completion until the user manually verifies — enables live bug discovery and fixing within the execution session
OTP codes for the dev environment can be retrieved directly from API server logs without needing email access

friction: cipher-box-ci-debug checkout had no .env files at all — had to discover and copy from the main cipher-box repo
Web dev server failed to start due to missing @cipherbox/sdk build — required building the full core → sdk-core → sdk dependency chain first
PostgreSQL host IP had changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) mid-session, breaking the API connection
Background task kills repeatedly terminated the API and web dev servers during the conversation, requiring multiple restarts
NestJS OpenAPI spec did not reflect DTO changes until both the class enum AND @ApiProperty decorator were updated — regenerating the API client produced stale types initially
Git lock file conflict required manual removal before commits could proceed
The dual-key IPNS wrapping required multiple iterations to get right (three separate bugs: empty fileMetaIpnsName → IPNS key not accessible → owner can't decrypt after recipient upload)
open_items: Silent revocation flow (403 handling, [RW] to [RO] transition, key zeroing) was listed as a UAT item but not explicitly confirmed tested
30-second polling behavior was not explicitly verified during UAT
The re-wrap fix for owner file edits (reWrapForRecipients) needs to handle the case where a file has no share recipients gracefully at scale
Files uploaded through shared folders before the fix (empty fileMetaIpnsName) cannot be retroactively fixed — only deletion and re-upload resolves them
The 'file-ipns' key type addition to share_keys is not documented in the share key schema — API schema and any documentation should be updated
E2E tests for writable shares were written but not run to verify they pass against the current implementation
The owner file update flow gap (not re-wrapping file keys for recipients) was a pre-existing issue beyond phase 27 scope — may affect other shared file types
